summary_en: Pasona Group agreed to tender all 1.44 million shares (32.31% stake) in Circlace, a digital consulting and SaaS company, to HHH1 LLC in a public tender offer scheduled for October 23–December 7, 2026. The sale is expected to generate approximately 2.6 billion yen in special gains on a consolidated basis for the fiscal year ending May 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Conclusion of Tender Offer Application Agreement for Shares in Affiliate Accounted for Using the Equity Method and Expected Recognition of Special Gains
translation_en_brief: On October 22, 2026, Pasona Group's board of directors resolved to tender all 1,440,000 shares (32.31% stake) held in Circlace Co., Ltd. to HHH1 LLC, which is conducting a public tender offer for Circlace's ordinary shares. The application agreement was executed on the same date. Circlace is a digital consulting and SaaS company that provides Salesforce implementation and maintenance services as well as proprietary SaaS products related to ServiceNow and cloud systems. Pasona has held shares in Circlace since its establishment in November 2012 and has leveraged synergies between the group's BPO solutions business and Circlace's digital tools development to support the company's expansion. However, amid intensifying competition in the IT sector driven by generative AI and other technological innovations, Pasona reconsidered Circlace's position within the group. The company determined that the tender offer is expected to enhance Circlace's medium- to long-term enterprise value and that the proposed purchase price is reasonable. If the tender offer is completed and Pasona's shares are sold, the company expects to recognize approximately 2.6 billion yen in gains on the sale of affiliate shares on a consolidated basis for the fiscal year ending May 2027. The tender offer period runs from October 23 through December 7, 2026, with settlement commencing on December 14, 2026. Following completion of the tender offer, Circlace will be deconsolidated from Pasona's equity method affiliates.
